# A Masmorra do Silêncio / The Silent Dungeon

> Browser-based dark fantasy text game with branching narrative, turn-based combat, Braille ASCII art, and a multi-act campaign. Free to play; Brazilian Portuguese and English UI.

## Play

- [Play in browser](https://ftuyama.github.io/silent-dungeon/): Official web version — no install required.

## About the game

- Genre: interactive fiction, dungeon crawler, dark fantasy RPG
- Platform: web browser (JavaScript required)
- Languages: Brazilian Portuguese (primary narrative), English (UI overlay)
- Tone: catacombs, cults, silence, moral choices; content warnings for death, cult themes, implied violence
- Mechanics: choices with consequences, turn-based combat, exploration hubs, factions (Vigília, Círculo, Culto), resources (supply, faith, corruption, gold)
